第一卷 第9章 古卷秘力悄洗凡躯（第1页）
院门一关，隔绝外界所有喧嚣与目光。
苏玄尘盘膝坐于石床之上，心神沉淀。
今日当众曝光极品天灵根，利弊已然清晰。
利，是宗门重视，资源倾斜，修行之路会顺畅许多。
弊，是彻底暴露在所有人视线之下，再无低调藏身的可能。
他不求张扬称霸，只求抓紧一切时间，修复朽躯、延续寿元、稳步破境。
泛黄书页静静铺开，古朴苍茫的气息隐隐内敛。
无人知晓，这本伴随他百年穿越的旧书，才是他真正的逆天底牌。
今日外界所有人，都在可惜他年岁太大、肉身朽坏、难成大器。
他的短板，恰恰可以被这古卷完美弥补。
更能潜移默化，温养肉身、涤荡经脉。
苏玄尘目光落在仅剩的九枚下品炼气丹上。
稍有不慎，必然引来高层探查，暴露至宝。
“少量提纯，循序渐进，绝不反常。”
取出一枚下品炼气丹，轻轻放入书页夹层之中，缓缓合拢书卷。
一枚莹白剔透、灵气充盈的极品炼气丹，静静躺在纸面之上。
比起下品丹药，药力至少强盛十倍不止！
磅礴温润的药力瞬间炸开，流转四肢百骸。
这一次，他刻意压制心神，引导药力细细冲刷每一寸老化经脉。
一丝丝淤积百年的污垢、杂质、死气，被药力缓缓冲刷剥离。
肉身深处沉寂百年的生机，一点点复苏、绽放。
他的肌肤不再只是肉眼可见的苍老。
内里的血肉、经脉、气血，正在悄然脱胎换骨。
极品天灵根的恐怖吸纳速度，配合极品丹药药力。
双重加持之下，他的修为飞速精进。
炼气一层的根基，彻底圆满、夯实、固化。
他一旦根基虚浮，日后境界越高，隐患越大，甚至会导致寿元彻底枯竭、爆体而亡。
一枚极品丹药力耗尽，肉身再强一分，经脉再通一寸。
天色渐晚，夕阳落山，暮色笼罩群山。
就在这时，院门外传来一道温和沉稳的仙音。
“苏玄尘师弟，随我去见执法长老。”

Volume 1 Chapter 9 The secret power of the ancient scroll quietly washes away the mortal body (Page 1)
Once the courtyard door is closed, all noise and eyes from the outside world are cut off.
Su Xuanchen sat cross-legged on the stone bed, his mind settled.
Today, the top-quality Tianling Root is exposed in public, and the pros and cons are already clear.
Profits are something that the sect attaches great importance to, and if resources are tilted towards it, the path of cultivation will be much smoother.
The disadvantage is that it is completely exposed to everyone's sight, and there is no possibility of hiding in a low profile.
He doesn't seek publicity and dominance, he just wants to seize every moment to repair his decayed body, extend his longevity, and steadily break through the realm.
The yellowed pages of the book are spread out quietly, and the simple and vast atmosphere is faintly restrained.
No one knows that this old book that has accompanied him for hundreds of years is his real trump card.
Today, everyone in the outside world is pity that he is too old, his body is decayed, and it is difficult for him to become a great person.
His shortcomings can be perfectly compensated by this ancient scroll.
It can also subtly warm and nourish the body and cleanse the meridians.
Su Xuanchen's eyes fell on the remaining nine low-grade Qi Refining Pills.
A little carelessness will inevitably lead to high-level investigation and expose the treasure.
"Purify in small amounts, step by step, never abnormal."
He took out a low-grade Qi Refining Pill, gently placed it between the pages of the book, and slowly closed the book.
A top-grade Qi Refining Pill, crystal clear and filled with spiritual energy, lay quietly on the paper.
Compared with low-grade elixirs, the medicine is at least ten times more powerful!
The majestic and warm medicinal power exploded instantly, flowing through the limbs and bones.
This time, he deliberately suppressed his mind and guided the power of the medicine to wash away every inch of the aging meridians.
Every trace of dirt, impurities, and dead air that had accumulated for hundreds of years were slowly washed away and peeled away by the power of the medicine.
The vitality deep in the body that has been dormant for hundreds of years is reviving and blooming bit by bit.
His skin is no longer just visibly old.
The flesh, blood, meridians, and qi and blood inside are quietly being reborn.
The terrifying absorption speed of the top-grade Tianling Root is combined with the power of the top-grade elixir.
Under the double blessing, his cultivation improved rapidly.
The foundation of the first level of Qi refining is completely completed, consolidated and solidified.
Once his foundation is illusory, the higher his level in the future, the greater the hidden dangers, which may even lead to complete depletion of longevity and death from explosion.
When the power of a top-grade elixir is exhausted, the physical body becomes stronger and the meridians become more open.
It was getting late, the sun was setting, and twilight enveloped the mountains.
At this moment, a gentle and steady fairy voice came from outside the courtyard gate.
"Junior Brother Su Xuanchen, follow me to see the law enforcement elder."
